【2024 湖北大学 10】已知某连续时间系统的微分方程为

\[
y ^ {\prime} (t) + 5 y (t) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} f (\tau) x (t - \tau) d \tau - f (t)
\]

解: \( y(t) + 5y(t) = f(t) * x(t) - f(t) \)
\( \Rightarrow h(t) + 5h(t) = \delta(t) * x(t) - \delta(t) = x(t) - \delta(t) = e^{-t}u(t) + 2\sqrt{t} \)
\( \Rightarrow h(t) = A e^{-5t} \) (齐次部分)
\( t > 0 \) 时，方切项 \( = e^{-t} \Rightarrow hp(t) = Be^{-t} \)
\( -Be^{-t} + 5Be^{-t} = e^{-t} \Rightarrow B = \frac{1}{4} \)
\( \Rightarrow h(t) = A e^{-5t} + \frac{1}{4}e^{-t} \)
\( \begin{cases} h(t) = a\sqrt{t} + b\Delta(u(t)) \Rightarrow a = 2 \\ h(t) = a\Delta(u(t)) \Rightarrow h(0+) = h(0-1) + 2 = 2 \\ h(0+) = A + \frac{1}{4} = 2 \Rightarrow A = \frac{7}{4} \\ \therefore h(t) = (\frac{7}{4}e^{-5t} + \frac{1}{4}e^{-t})u(t) \end{cases} \)
